subject: Procurement kickoff + demo — scheduling and agenda
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sujata Rao <sujata@acme-corp.com>, Tom Hargreaves <tom.h@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff + demo — scheduling and agenda

Hi Sujata & Tom,

Thanks for the call earlier — excited to get Acme onboarded. To kick off procurement and vendor onboarding we typically do a 60–75 minute session that covers:
- 15m: introductions + goals
- 25m: hosted demo (AE + SE) + live Q&A
- 15m: procurement / contract & billing next steps
- 10m: security & operational checklist review (SOC2, network, KMS)

Attaching our onboarding checklist and a SOC 2 summary to speed the procurement review. Can you confirm who from your procurement and security teams should join? I've copied Dev (SE) to cover technical questions.

Proposed time slots (PT):
- Tuesday, Nov 3 — 10:00–11:15am PT
- Wednesday, Nov 4 — 2:00–3:15pm PT
- Thursday, Nov 5 — 9:00–10:15am PT

If none of those work, please suggest 2–3 windows (we'll do our best to accommodate). Once confirmed I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda and pre-reads.

Attachments:
- Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (attachment)
- SOC2_Summary.pdf (attachment)

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

---
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff + demo — scheduling and agenda

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — this looks good. Please include our security lead Alex Li (alex.li@acme-corp.com) on the invite; he'll handle SOC2/technical controls. Procurement asked for a separate 15-minute pre-call to confirm our vendor setup and billing requirements; can we add that before the demo or include procurement in the first 10 minutes?

Of the times you proposed, Nov 4 at 2pm PT would work best for the wider group if that's still available. If you need flexibility, Nov 5 morning is also a fallback.

Sujata Rao
Head of Product Operations, Acme Corp

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff + demo — scheduling and agenda

Thanks Sujata — I'll plan to cover the demo surface and leave time for deep tech Qs. For the security/prior auth items I suggest we:
- Share a short packet of technical requirements (network, ports, allowed egress, KMS/HSM expectations) ahead of time
- Reserve 15 minutes during the demo for Alex to ask any architecture questions

I've attached a quick tech requirements spreadsheet that maps the items procurement typically asks about (network, retention, encryption). If there are specific SSO/KMS docs you need, flag them and I'll include links.

Attachment:
- tech-requirements.xlsx (attachment)

—Dev

- 9:00–9:15am PT: Introductions & goals (Marissa, Sujata)
- 9:15–9:45am PT: Hosted demo + feature Qs (Marissa + Dev)
- 9:45–10:00am PT: Security & architecture questions (Alex, Dev, Michael)
- 10:00–10:15am PT: Next steps: contract/DocuSign, timelines, internal owners (Marissa + Procurement)

Pre-reads & links:
- Redwood onboarding checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-redwood-onboarding

- Draft mutual action plan: https://drive.google.com/open?id=map-acme-redwood

Marissa
